title: glyceria occidentalis
intro: Glyceria occidentalis, commonly known as Western Marsh Grass-pink or Western Marsh Grass-pink sedge, is a perennial aquatic plant species belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Glyceria occidentalis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Glyceria occidentalis may provide antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, supporting its use in traditional medicine for various health conditions.
